outcomes: AWS's post-event summary says an automated activity to scale capacity of one service in the main AWS network triggered unexpected behaviour from many clients in the internal network, a surge of connections overwhelmed the devices between the two networks and delayed communication; monitoring was impaired, which slowed finding the cause, and customers could not change DNS entries in Route 53 from 7:30 AM to 2:30 PM PST while existing DNS answers were not affected.
